news-korea-econ.title: U.S. Tariffs 60 Trading Partners, Including Europe and China, for Slave Labor Product Imports

USTR Jamieson Greer announced “tariffs on 60 economies for their failure to impose and effectively enforce a prohibition" on forced labor.
